verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਊ ਦਾਦੇ ਜੇਵੇਹਾ ਪੜਦਾਦੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਪੜੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: peeuoo dhaadhe jevehaa paRadhaadhe paravaan paRotaa|

en.bdb: Spiritual Great Grandfather Guru Nanak’s grandson, Guru Ram Das, has attained greatness like his spiritual father, Guru Amar Das, and his grandfather, Guru Angad, and is embraced by the congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਦਾ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੌੜਾ ਸੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat jaag jagaidhaa kalijug a(n)dhar kauaRaa sotaa|

en.bdb: Having been awakened by Guru's instruction, he in turn awakens the dark age (Kaliyug) from deep slumber.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਦਾ ਥੰਮੁ ਹੁਇ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਥਰਬਣ ਥੰਮੑਹਿ ਖਲੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: dheen dhunee dhaa tha(n)m hui bhaar atharaban tha(n)m(h)h khalotaa|

en.bdb: For dharma and the world he stands like a supporting pillar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲ ਭਉ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਚੜਿ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਗੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhaujal bhau na viaapiee gur bohith chaR khai na gotaa|

en.bdb: Whosoever has mounted the vessel of the Guru, is not scared of the world world ocean; and he is not to drown in it

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਹਟ ਨਾਲੈ ਵਣਜ ਸਓਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: avagun lai gun vikanai gur haT naalai vanaj sotaa|

en.bdb: Here virtues are sold for evils - such is the profitable shop of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੂਲ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: miliaa mool na vichhuRai ratan padhaarath haar parotaa|

en.bdb: Once visited none gets separated from him who has put on the garland of the pearls of virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਵਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਧੋਤਾ।
verses.translit_en: mailaa kadhe na hoviee gur saravar niramal jal dhotaa|

en.bdb: Washed himself in the pure water of the tank of the Guru's love, one never gets soiled again.
In the family of great grand father (Guru Nanak) he (Guru Ram Das) stands like a detached lotus.
